### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A/P-Section]: Limit diagnostic statements to conditions explicitly mentioned or clearly confirmed by the provider; do not infer specific diagnoses (e.g., ARDS) from general symptoms or broader diagnostic categories.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: When reporting symptom durations, strictly adhere to the patient's explicit statements; do not infer or extend durations from other symptoms or general timeframes.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[A/P-Section]: Strictly adhere to provider's explicit diagnostic statements and etiological considerations in the assessment; do not infer specific diagnoses (e.g., ARDS) or elevate diagnostic possibilities from the Plan section to assessment conclusions.
[A-Section]: Avoid clinical interpretations or pathophysiological explanations (e.g., 'inflammatory response', 'hypoxemia') unless explicitly stated by the provider.
